description: This file defines the internal class SiloStatusOracle, which manages silo status information within the Orleans runtime membership service. It interacts with membership snapshots, tracks active silos, and provides status querying functionalities.

classes.name: SiloStatusOracle
classes.description: The class manages and provides silo status information, including cache management, status queries, and subscription to status events within the Orleans runtime system.

methods.name: SiloStatusOracle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SiloStatusOracle with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the approximate status of a given silo, logging when a silo is not registered.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an immutable array of currently active silos, ensuring the cache is up to date.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of silo statuses, filtered to only active silos if specified.

methods.name: EnsureFreshCache
methods.description: Updates the cached silo statuses if the membership snapshot has changed.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Determines if a silo is dead based on its status.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a silo is functioning as a directory, considering termination status.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Attempts to get the silo name from the membership snapshot for a given address.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to silo status events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from silo status events.

methods.name: LogSiloAddressNotRegistered
methods.description: Logs a debug message when a silo address is not registered.
